title: Owwyl: AI bookkeeping that closes the books overnight
overview:
Goal: small businesses needed their books closed every night without a bookkeeper, and owners needed to see only the one item that genuinely needs a person.

What we built: Owwyl, an AI accounting product. It reads the bank feed, the card processor and the bills inbox as one stream, matches every bill to the payment that settled it, and posts real double-entry. When it is not sure, it holds the transaction and explains why, instead of guessing. It includes a reconciliation queue ranked by confidence, a month-end close checklist that checks itself, exceptions that flag when subledgers do not tie to the ledger, and 40 financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, A/R and A/P aging, tax and payroll) generated live from the ledger.

Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/Postgres, Stripe Financial Connections, Xero import.

Result: a working multi-tenant product live at owwyl.com, running a real business's books every night.

title: Secure client portal with MFA, SSO and encrypted documents
overview:
Goal: give clients one secure place to receive deliverables, sign contracts and pay, with security good enough for schools and public agencies.

What we built: a client portal with required multi-factor sign-in, single sign-on, encrypted document storage, code-protected outside sharing, time-limited staff access and a full access history. Clients see their deliverables, contracts awaiting signature, billing and team in one calm interface. Shown with a demo organization.

Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase with row-level security, encrypted storage.

Result: live for LOVELEEDAY clients at portal.loveleedaystudios.com.

title: LOVELEEDAY: brand and website for an intelligence operating system
overview:
Goal: explain a complex product (Arthur, an intelligence system that connects records, preserves memory and grounds answers in evidence) in a way a business owner understands in seconds.

What we built: the complete LOVELEEDAY brand and website: positioning, copy, photography direction, an interactive system preview, use-case pages (municipal review, customer data, pricing and margins, operational intelligence), a security page and a project-brief tool. Fast, accessible and consistent across 20+ pages.

Result: live at loveleedaystudios.com.

title: Pricing and margin analysis: see what sells and what it leaves
overview:
Goal: help distributors, manufacturers and retailers see where margin is being lost between the listed price and what a sale actually leaves after discounts and variable costs.

What we built: a margin review workflow that reconciles catalogue items with cost records, realized selling prices, discounts and fees; flags losses, margins below target and missing or outdated costs; and proposes item-level price changes with every assumption kept attached. Includes an interactive contribution-margin calculator.

Result: a reviewable pricing plan instead of a spreadsheet guess, built from the team's experience running annual price rolls across thousands of SKUs.

title: Owwyl: brand identity and marketing site concepts
overview:
Goal: make an AI bookkeeping product's marketing site look like a major brand and match the product it sells.

What we did: a full design review of 100 live pages, research across current fintech brands, six logo directions, six type-and-colour systems with measured accessibility contrast, and five complete homepage concepts built in the product's own design system, using real product screens and licensed photography.

Result: a clear, testable set of directions for the client to choose from, delivered in a day.
